posts.title: Developers, It's a good time to evaluate your threat model
posts.description: AI-driven vulnerability discovery has changed the calculus of what constitutes an acceptable risk. Evaluate your threat model with practical suggestions for sandboxing, disposability, network segmentation, and reducing your attack surface as a developer.
